title_zh: 把拼图研究结论限定为本任务表现

scenario.label_zh: 审视拼图成绩的推论边界
scenario.goal_zh: 区分特定任务表现与整体智力，并依据练习影响修订课堂研究结论

context_zh: 心理学课学生检查一项课堂拼图练习的结论。
author: author-phase08-c

sentences.speaker: Tariq
sentences.text: Our psychology report says the fastest person on the puzzle was the most intelligent. Is that justified?

sentences.speaker: Jo
sentences.text: No. Some people had already done that type of puzzle, and others had never seen one.

sentences.speaker: Tariq
sentences.text: So speed wasn't purely a measure of the ability we wanted to test.

sentences.speaker: Jo
sentences.text: Right. Practice could affect the result, and one task doesn't measure someone's overall intelligence.

sentences.speaker: Tariq
sentences.text: I'll change the conclusion to say who completed this task fastest under these conditions.

sentences.speaker: Jo
sentences.text: And note the difference in previous practice as a limitation.

sentences.speaker: Tariq
sentences.text: Done. The revised conclusion no longer ranks people's intelligence.
